design_decisions.decision: wrapper-instance volatile field + request attribute (com.snoworca.adapter.requestId) hybrid — attribute first miss falls back to instance cache → generate UUID + write both.
design_decisions.rationale: Sidecar action specifies attribute-based caching for cross-wrapper sharing on the same underlying request. However TDD fake (java.lang.reflect.Proxy returning null for getAttribute) cannot persist attributes → AC-1 'first == second' would fail. Hybrid satisfies both (real container request: attribute-shared; bare/proxy: instance-scoped).

AdapterUnwrapAllClassesTest scan policy requires every concrete class under adapter.jakarta.servlet6 to implement AdapterUnwrap. Initial impl without marker triggered regression in FR-CONV-003 AC-1.
